snapshot_guards.description: Optional stateless retry fence mapping every requested file, plus any completed sibling files, to the SHA-256 returned by a prior selector-local continuation. Every requested file must be present. All guarded files are captured and verified before request evaluation; mismatch refuses without source or continuation.

workspace_root.description: Optional canonical absolute workspace root. Omit to use the server default. Preserve the returned workspace_root in follow-up calls.

label.description: Optional cosmetic site namespace. Must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$; for example rename produces rename/s01. Omit for change/s01.

form.description: Exact-source route only: one exact named top-level form. Use together with file instead of subject/subjects.

owners.description: Exact-source route only: ordered project-relative file/form owners compiled into one basis without a semantic index.

expect.description: Exact aggregate counts. files is the number of distinct file paths across all requests; count repeated paths once.

files.description: Exact number of distinct request file paths; repeated paths count once.

verify.description: Omit for changed-file verification. Use full only when the user explicitly requests the complete repository suite.

context.description: Return the complete named form from the retained snapshot.

scope.description: Semantic preparation defaults to surface. Exact file/form preparation supports and defaults to definition.

subject.description: One fully qualified Clojure Var: namespace/name.

subjects.description: Related fully qualified Vars to resolve as one proof union.

open.description: Ordered retained site IDs, for example rename/s01.

requests.description: Ordered all-or-nothing structural read requests with unique IDs.

include_source.description: Set false for metadata-only form reads; line ranges, source character counts, hashes, and source anchors remain, while exact source bodies are omitted. Omit for exact source.

match.description: Exactly one structural Clojure form pattern; _ matches one subtree.

expression.description: Existing capability-limited :xray :expr program. Example: (-> (form 'numeric-fields) initializer (expect-count 1) (analyze (fn [[fields]] (count fields))))
